# IntegroAI Consulting

> IntegroAI Consulting is an independent, technology-agnostic AI consultancy based in the UK. It helps founder-led service businesses reduce repetitive work, improve operational control and create capacity for growth. The work starts with operational clarity: identifying what needs to improve before a business invests in an AI solution.

- Founder: Selina Fischer, independent AI consultant, who leads every engagement personally.
- Best suited to: founder-led service businesses, and the founders, leaders and operations teams within them.
- Approach: the IntegroAI Operating Framework, a five-stage method for responsible AI implementation: Discover, Design, Validate, Deliver and Iterate. People stay in control at every stage.
- Pricing: scoped individually. There is no obligation until scope and cost are agreed.
- Contact: info@integroai.tech

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://integroai.tech/): what IntegroAI does, who it works with and frequently asked questions.
- [Free 5-Minute AI Readiness Assessment](https://integroai.tech/assessment): gives an initial view of how ready a business is for AI, with a readiness score and the priority to focus on first.
- [Work With Me](https://integroai.tech/work-with-me): how engagements work, stage by stage.
- [About](https://integroai.tech/about): the consultancy, its mission, vision and values, and Selina's story.
- [Book a free 30-minute Discovery Call](https://calendly.com/integroai-tech/30min)

## Services

- AI Readiness Assessment: a free 5-minute self-assessment for a first indication of where a business stands.
- AI & Operations Diagnostic: the starting point for every engagement. A consultant-led review that shows what is slowing the business down, what to fix first and where AI is worth the investment. The client then chooses what to act on first, and each next stage is agreed before it begins.
- AI Foundations & Responsible Adoption: put the right foundations in place for AI to work safely, responsibly and sustainably.
- AI & Automation Implementation: turn validated opportunities into working solutions with a clear business case.
- Ongoing AI & Operations Advisory: keep implemented changes delivering value as the business and technology evolve.
- AI Voice Receptionist: an AI phone assistant that answers 24/7, books appointments, takes messages and passes callers to the team when needed.
- Website Design & Build: a professional website, designed, built and launched for the business.
- AI Search Visibility (AEO & GEO): a review of how Google and AI tools see a business, then improvements to the clarity, consistency and content that help it get recommended.

## Free guide

- [Does AI know your business exists?](https://integroai.tech/ai-visibility-guide): a practical guide and checklist on being found, understood and recommended in the age of AI search. Covers SEO, AEO and GEO: find me, answer me, recommend me.
